guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：磁流變光學拋光
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Magnetorheological optical finishing
guides.concept: 從羰基鐵粒子在磁場中成鏈、形成具降伏應力的流體帶談起，用 Preston 關係與 D 形去除點建立磁流變拋光的去除模型，再把拋光輪、流體黏度閉迴路、工件材料與次表面損傷、干涉量測與去除點校正、誤差預算，直到清洗與驗收交接，整合成一條可重複的非球面修形流程。
guides.conceptEn: Start with carbonyl-iron particles chaining in a magnetic field into a ribbon with a yield stress, model removal with the Preston relation and the D-shaped spot, then integrate the wheel, fluid-viscosity loop, workpiece materials and subsurface damage, interferometry and spot calibration, error budget, cleaning and acceptance into a repeatable aspheric figuring process.
procedure: 磁流變液是水基懸浮液，含有直徑約 4 µm 的羰基鐵粒子、拋光用的氧化鈰或奈米鑽石磨料以及穩定劑。無磁場時它是黏度約 0.5 Pa·s 的流體，可被泵送到旋轉輪面；進入電磁鐵上方約 0.2 到 0.4 T 的區域後，鐵粒子沿磁力線成鏈，流體在毫秒內變成具有降伏應力的賓漢塑性體，形成一條硬化的「流體帶」。工件以約 0.5 mm 的深度浸入帶中，磨料被磁場梯度推向帶的表面，材料去除由這個受控的剪切流決定，而不是由硬質拋光工具的壓力決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「磁流變液帶與電磁鐵」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

材料去除率遵循 Preston 關係：單位時間去除深度正比於介面應力與相對速度的乘積，比例常數 k_p 由材料、磨料與化學環境決定。工件靜止在流體帶中時，去除集中在一個 D 形的去除點，長軸沿輪面運動方向約 10 mm、寬約 4 mm，深度分佈由帶內剪切應力與磨料分佈決定。去除點是整個修形的單位脈衝：工件沿螺旋或光柵軌跡移動，實際去除等於去除點函數與駐留時間的卷積，去除點一旦量準，修形便是確定性的。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「D 形去除點與 Preston 關係」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

機台把流體從調節槽泵到噴嘴，鋪在直徑約 150 mm 的旋轉輪面上，流過電磁鐵極靴上方的工作區後被刮刀回收，回到調節槽重新混合與控溫。因為水會蒸發、鐵粒子會氧化，調節迴路用流量與壓降推算黏度，並自動補水把黏度維持在設定值，這是去除率穩定的關鍵。工件由多軸數控平台握持，三軸機可修平面與淺曲面，修非球面與自由曲面需五軸讓表面法線始終對準流體帶。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「拋光輪、噴嘴與流體調節迴路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

不同材料的 Preston 常數差異很大：矽酸鹽玻璃配氧化鈰去除快，熔融石英較慢，藍寶石與碳化矽需要奈米鑽石磨料且去除率低一個數量級。磁流變拋光的法向載荷小、以剪切為主，因此不會產生新的次表面損傷，反而能去除前段研磨與拋光留下的微裂紋層，表面粗糙度可達 0.5 到 1 nm RMS。對軟質或水溶性晶體，流體的水基環境與化學作用必須另外評估，否則會出現腐蝕紋或霧化。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「工件材料與次表面損傷層」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

修形迴路的輸入是干涉儀的面形圖：球面用參考球面直接量，非球面需電腦全像（CGH）零檢鏡或子孔徑拼接，自由曲面則用拼接或輪廓儀。量測圖必須對位到機台座標，機台用工件邊緣與基準記號定位，位置誤差乘上局部斜率成為去除誤差。每次修形前先在工件本身或同材料試片上打一個去除點並量測，取得當天的峰值去除率與點形，去除率的日漂移通常為百分之幾，這就是校正不能省略的原因。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「干涉儀與去除點校正紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

一次修形後的殘差由獨立項的均方根組成：去除率漂移乘以去除深度、量測重複性、對位誤差乘以斜率，以及去除點沿軌跡變化留下的中頻紋理。因為去除點寬度只有幾毫米，光柵或螺旋軌跡的步距若接近點寬會留下週期性波紋，步距小於點寬的一半時波紋被去除點本身平滑掉。磁流變拋光通常每次迭代可把低頻面形縮小 5 到 10 倍，但中頻紋理決定了收斂平台，必要時由後續小步距的「平滑」趟次或離子束處理。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「修形誤差預算與中頻紋理」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

磁流變拋光接在精磨或傳統拋光之後：前段提供可量測的面形與受控的粗糙度，磁流變負責去除損傷層與確定性修形，之後視規格再接離子束。因為去除靠剪切流，工件邊緣沒有壓力式工具的塌邊，但軌跡仍需讓去除點完整越過邊緣以維持均勻性。修形後工件表面殘留鐵粒子與乾涸流體，必須在數分鐘內用去離子水沖洗並以適當清潔程序處理，否則鐵鏽斑與水痕會在鍍膜前留下缺陷；鏡片的斜面與邊緣也需檢查是否有流體殘留。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「製程鏈、邊緣處理與清洗」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

透鏡表面誤差對穿透波前的影響是 (n − 1) 倍，反射面則是 2 倍，驗收前必須把表面 RMS 換算成系統要求的波前量，並註明是否扣除傾斜、離焦與使用的空間濾波。交接資料應包含最終面形圖與 Zernike 係數、分頻段 PSD、修形前後粗糙度、去除點校正紀錄、流體批號與黏度日誌、總去除深度與清洗紀錄，使鍍膜與組裝端能評估殘留風險。獨立儀器的複測是驗收的核心，而不是只核對機台自己的量測。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收報告與穿透波前換算」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: An MR fluid is a water-based suspension of roughly 4 µm carbonyl-iron particles, cerium-oxide or nanodiamond polishing abrasive and stabilisers. Without a field it is a liquid of about 0.5 Pa·s that can be pumped onto a rotating wheel; above the electromagnet, in a field of about 0.2 to 0.4 T, the iron particles chain along field lines and within milliseconds the fluid becomes a Bingham plastic with a yield stress, forming a stiffened ribbon. The workpiece is immersed about 0.5 mm into the ribbon, the field gradient pushes abrasive toward the ribbon surface, and removal is governed by this controlled shear flow rather than by the pressure of a hard tool. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “MR ribbon and electromagnet”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Removal follows the Preston relation: depth removed per unit time is proportional to the product of interfacial stress and relative velocity, with a constant k_p set by material, abrasive and chemistry. With the part held still in the ribbon the removal concentrates in a D-shaped spot about 10 mm long along the wheel motion and 4 mm wide, its depth profile set by the shear stress and abrasive distribution in the ribbon. The spot is the unit impulse of the whole process: the part moves along a spiral or raster path, actual removal equals the convolution of the spot function with dwell time, and once the spot is measured the figuring is deterministic. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “D-shaped removal spot and the Preston relation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The machine pumps fluid from a conditioning tank to a nozzle, lays it on a rotating wheel of about 150 mm diameter, carries it through the working zone above the electromagnet pole pieces, scrapes it off and returns it to the tank for remixing and temperature control. Because water evaporates and iron oxidises, the loop infers viscosity from flow and pressure drop and adds water automatically to hold the setpoint, which is the key to a stable removal rate. A multi-axis CNC stage holds the part; three axes suffice for flats and shallow curves, while aspheres and freeforms need five axes to keep the surface normal aligned to the ribbon. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Wheel, nozzle and fluid-conditioning loop”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Preston constants differ widely between materials: silicate glass with cerium oxide removes quickly, fused silica more slowly, and sapphire or silicon carbide need nanodiamond abrasive with rates an order of magnitude lower. Because MRF applies a small normal load and works by shear, it creates no new subsurface damage and instead strips the microcrack layer left by earlier grinding and polishing, reaching 0.5 to 1 nm RMS roughness. For soft or water-soluble crystals the aqueous chemistry of the fluid must be assessed separately or etch texture and haze appear. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Workpiece material and subsurface-damage layer”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The loop's input is an interferometric map: spheres are measured against a reference sphere, aspheres need a computer-generated-hologram null or sub-aperture stitching, and freeforms use stitching or profilometry. The map must be registered to machine coordinates using the part edge and fiducials, since position error times local slope becomes removal error. Before each run a spot is made and measured on the part itself or a witness of the same material to obtain that day's peak rate and spot shape; day-to-day drift of a few percent is why calibration cannot be skipped. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Interferometer and spot-calibration record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The post-run residual is the root-sum-square of independent terms: rate drift times removal depth, measurement repeatability, registration error times slope, and the mid-frequency texture left by spot variation along the path. Because the spot is only a few millimetres wide, a raster or spiral pitch close to the spot width leaves periodic ripple, while a pitch below half the spot width is smoothed by the spot itself. MRF typically shrinks low-frequency figure by 5 to 10 times per iteration, but mid-frequency texture sets the convergence floor, handled if needed by a fine-pitch smoothing pass or ion-beam finishing. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Figuring error budget and mid-frequency texture”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

MRF follows fine grinding or conventional polishing: the earlier stages supply a measurable figure and controlled roughness, MRF removes the damage layer and performs deterministic figuring, and ion-beam finishing may follow depending on specification. Because removal is by shear flow there is no pressure-tool edge roll, but the path must still carry the spot fully across the edge for uniformity. After the run the surface holds iron particles and drying fluid; it must be rinsed with deionised water within minutes and cleaned by a suitable procedure, or rust spots and water marks become coating defects, and bevels and edges must be checked for trapped fluid. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Process chain, edge handling and cleaning”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A lens surface error enters the transmitted wavefront (n − 1) times, a mirror surface 2 times, so before acceptance the surface RMS must be converted to the wavefront quantity the system requires, stating whether tilt and focus were removed and which spatial filter was used. The handoff package should contain the final map with Zernike coefficients, band-limited PSDs, roughness before and after, the spot-calibration record, fluid batch and viscosity log, total removal depth and cleaning record, so coating and assembly can judge residual risk. Re-measurement on an independent instrument is the core of acceptance, not a check of the machine's own data. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance report and transmitted-wavefront conversion”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 鐵粒子氧化或流體含水量變化會讓降伏應力與黏度漂移，去除點深度在一天內變化超過 10%，用舊校正值執行的駐留圖留下與誤差圖同形的殘差。
CGH 零檢鏡與干涉儀未對準，產生假的彗差被當成真實面形修掉，修形後實際面形多了一個相反的彗差項，而用另一台儀器驗收時才發現。
pitfallsEn: Oxidised iron particles or a change in water content shift yield stress and viscosity, the spot depth drifts by more than 10% within a day, and a dwell map run with the old calibration leaves a residual shaped like the error map.

A misaligned CGH null produces false coma that is figured out as if it were real, so the finished surface carries a coma of opposite sign, discovered only when acceptance is run on a different instrument.

related.title: 非球面光學加工
related.transfer: 可遷移「磁流變效應與降伏應力流體帶」與「面形量測、CGH 零檢與去除點校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；非球面光學加工的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Magnetorheological effect and the yield-stress ribbon" and "Figure metrology, CGH null test and spot calibration" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Aspheric-optics manufacturing must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以磁場硬化的磁流變液帶、Preston 去除關係與去除點校正，確定性修正非球面面形；非球面光學加工則以非球面矢高方程、中頻誤差、確定性拋光、鑽石車削與模造、非球面量測與對心公差為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on deterministic aspheric figure correction with a field-stiffened MR ribbon, Preston removal relation and spot calibration; Aspheric-optics manufacturing centres on aspheric sag equation, mid-spatial-frequency error, deterministic polishing, diamond turning and molding, asphere metrology and centring tolerances, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「磁流變液帶與電磁鐵」與「非球面矢高方程與圓錐常數」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到非球面光學加工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「非球面對心靈敏度與誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “MR ribbon and electromagnet” and “Aspheric sag equation and conic constant”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Aspheric-optics manufacturing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Aspheric centring sensitivity and the error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 離子束光學表面修形
related.transfer: 可遷移「磁流變效應與降伏應力流體帶」與「面形量測、CGH 零檢與去除點校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；離子束光學表面修形的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Magnetorheological effect and the yield-stress ribbon" and "Figure metrology, CGH null test and spot calibration" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以磁場硬化的磁流變液帶、Preston 去除關係與去除點校正，確定性修正非球面面形；離子束光學表面修形則以以濺射去除函數與駐留時間反卷積，把拋光後的面形誤差收斂到奈米級為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on deterministic aspheric figure correction with a field-stiffened MR ribbon, Preston removal relation and spot calibration; Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces centres on converging polished figure error to the nanometre level with a sputter removal function and dwell-time deconvolution, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「磁流變液帶與電磁鐵」與「氬離子束與工件表面」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到離子束光學表面修形，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「誤差預算與收斂極限」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “MR ribbon and electromagnet” and “Argon-ion beam and workpiece surface”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Error budget and convergence limit", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 磁流變光學拋光
history.text: 磁流變拋光的概念由 William Kordonski 與同事在 1980 年代末於明斯克提出，1990 年代在羅徹斯特大學光學製造中心由 Jacobs、Golini 與 Kordonski 等人發展成確定性的光學修形技術，1996 年成立的 QED Technologies 把它商品化為數控機台，2001 年該技術獲得美國國防部的製造技術獎。此後磁流變拋光成為非球面、自由曲面與高功率雷射光學的標準修形工具，與離子束修形互補。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯，不涉及任何流體配方。
history.textEn: The magnetorheological finishing concept was proposed by William Kordonski and colleagues in Minsk in the late 1980s, developed in the 1990s at the University of Rochester Center for Optics Manufacturing by Jacobs, Golini, Kordonski and others into a deterministic optical figuring technique, commercialised as CNC machines by QED Technologies, founded in 1996, and recognised with a U.S. Department of Defense manufacturing-technology award in 2001. MRF has since become a standard figuring tool for aspheres, freeforms and high-power laser optics, complementary to ion-beam figuring. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic, not any fluid formulation.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「磁流變效應與降伏應力流體帶」到「規格換算、驗收與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Magnetorheological effect and the yield-stress ribbon" through "Specification conversion, acceptance and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
